propositions: Plan review must classify every acceptance-criterion checkbox as either codebase-verifiable or operator-attested, requiring criterion-specific evidence for each classification decision.

Externally verifiable criteria lacking the exact case-insensitive [operator-attested] tag must produce a remediation finding naming the exact required syntax; internally verifiable criteria carrying this tag must produce a finding explaining that ticket comments cannot substitute for repository proof.

The new blocking criterion must detect both error directions: missing or malformed tags on external criteria, and [operator-attested] tags on codebase-verifiable criteria, while preserving ADR 0043 fail-safe semantics.

Evidence-kind misclassification findings must participate in normal validity × impact blocking policy, while deterministic keyword detection remains advisory/fail-open, and the criterion must not weaken the completion verifier's trust boundary or add external-service access.

Frozen-corpus evaluation over named historical cases (A1, 115b, 8c4f, malformed tags, over-tagged code, mixed-evidence items) must achieve 100% precision on genuine-external negatives, 100% recall on named fixtures, and macro precision/recall ≥ 0.90 across the full corpus with no regression of previously passing fixtures.

Registry completeness, criteria routing, reviewer resources, generated docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md, and author guidance must describe the new check and ADR 0043 exact-tag semantics without drift, verified by repository generation/drift gates.
